correctness.rationale: Ordinary automorphisms necessarily have the form (v,t)↦(Av,det(A)t+ℓ(v)), by preservation of the one-dimensional derived center and the alternating determinant bracket, valid also in characteristic two. Necessity of homogeneous T, nonzero central scalar, quotient-independent central shift, independent-direction preservation and fiber injectivity follows by choosing witnesses for scalar, independent-quotient and equal-quotient pairs. Sufficiency exhausts independent noncentral, proportional noncentral, one central and both central cases; in the proportional case fiber injectivity gives residual r′=0 iff r=0, permitting a nonzero prescribed det(A). A change of representatives introduces no overcount, so a projective permutation, q+1 nonzero lifts, q+1 field permutations, and central multiplier give the asserted exact count. Independently enumerated the 24 actual automorphisms over F₂ and all 8!=40320 bijections by exact ordered-pair orbit preservation; precisely 48 qualify. This finite case corroborates rather than proves the all-field theorem.

final_claim: For every field k, all possibly nonlinear two-local automorphisms of the three-dimensional Heisenberg Lie algebra are exactly homogeneous projective injections with injective homogeneous central-fiber maps and one nonzero central scalar; over F_q the number is (q-1)^(q+2)(q+1)!(q!)^(q+1), with automatic bijectivity.
